source.archive: Cui, Li, and Zhou OSF replication archive
source.source_article: Desmichel, Ordabayeva, and Kocher (2020), What if diamonds did not last forever? Signaling status achievement through ephemeral versus iconic luxury goods
authorized_normalizations: Removed the archive's generic LLM wrapper and reason-generation request.
Separated the shared dinner-and-wine recommendation frame from the three wine descriptions.
Locked the two achieved-status items as primary and retained ascribed status, general status, and creativity as secondary outcomes.

population.simulation_target: Adult evaluating a colleague from a wine recommendation

materials.participant_role: Act as one adult participant evaluating a colleague who recommends a prestigious wine. Respond for yourself, do not predict the average person, and do not analyze the experiment.
materials.common_scenario: You are chatting with a colleague and mention that you invited guests to dinner next week whom you want to impress. You ask for advice about an appropriate bottle of wine. The colleague recommends a prestigious, excellent wine worth its price.

ephemeral_luxury.label: Ephemeral prestigious wine
ephemeral_luxury.stimulus: The wine comes from a grape variety whose flavors change every year. The grapes, production method, and packaging are constantly renewed and updated. Every tasting will be different; the wine is constantly reinvented.

iconic_luxury.label: Iconic prestigious wine
iconic_luxury.stimulus: The wine comes from a grape variety that existed in the eighteenth century. The grapes, production method, and packaging have remained unchanged. It tastes the same year after year; the wine is timeless.

generic_luxury_control.label: Generic prestigious wine control
generic_luxury_control.stimulus: The wine comes from a grape variety with a good reputation. The colleague mentions its grapes, production method, and packaging. The wine will be exquisite; it is a great wine.

materials.response_instruction: Rate every item from 1 (strongly disagree) to 7 (strongly agree) and return only integer item responses in the required JSON structure.

items.text: The colleague's achieved status is high.
The colleague made great efforts to reach their status.
The colleague's ascribed status is high.
The colleague has a privileged social background.
The colleague is a high-status person.
The colleague suggests new ways to achieve goals or objectives.
The colleague comes up with new and practical ideas to improve performance.
The colleague suggests new ways to increase quality.
The colleague is a good source of creative ideas.
The colleague is not afraid to take risks.
The colleague exhibits creativity on the job when given the opportunity.
The colleague often has new and innovative ideas.
The colleague comes up with creative solutions to problems.
The colleague often has a fresh approach to problems.
The colleague suggests new ways of performing work tasks.

research_restricted.aligned_hypothesis_text: Ephemeral luxury signals greater achieved status than iconic luxury.
research_restricted.reversed_hypothesis_text: Iconic luxury signals greater achieved status than ephemeral luxury.
